1. PASS — Two cream pillars bend inward into a thick overhead beam; lower glass has no extra rib lattice.

5. PASS — Four named views, including a large readable DASH CLOSE-UP.
6. PASS — More expressive instrument shapes and asymmetric mounts; no cables, keypads, switch banks or extra screens.

Labels present: SYSTEM SCREEN, TARGET SCREEN, ENGINE GAUGE, THROTTLE / SPEED BAR, WARP GLYPH, SPARE, PILLAR, SEAT, EYE, BUBBLE 2.6 m; 1.8 m figure; all four view names and seven legend entries. Pilot view has no body or boots; top plan has one seat.

Open-glass target: FAIL — Visual inspection does not support approximately two-thirds. Pale-blue pixels occupy 51.0% of the pilot-view bounding rectangle (26,30–775,554); this conservative proxy includes off-white corners. Minor shading remains, and the instrument legend swatch drifted toward teal.
